description: Reusable multi-DOF rigid rigs, immutable pose libraries, arbitrary clip batches, unified temporal delivery, and exhaustive visual admission
deviation_notes: Contract groundwork may proceed while the predecessor S14 visual gate is pending, but public authoring, temporal delivery, and pack admission cannot bypass the predecessor's Kimi acceptance. A fourth independent audit corrected nested approval-composition, cleanup-error precedence, aggregate-budget classification, and mirror-path addressability gaps. The fifth checkpoint invalidated the prior final typecheck claim until strict bracket access and the actual project typecheck passed; a sixth independent checkpoint now confirms the S1/S2 mechanical slice with no findings. S1 and S2 remain in progress pending a current full coverage pass, manual verification, and user-authorized checkpoint handling. The one-worker full coverage attempt was environment-red under severe host load and swap pressure; five affected files passed independently and two remained timeout-only without assertion mismatches. S3 isolated clip-library contracts and deterministic evaluator core are mechanically green after an independent audit found and confirmed repairs for malformed partial requests, budget-error precedence, and foreign mirror hooks. Explicit V2 barrel aliases preserve legacy symbols, generated facts and the immutable 84-file delivery claim are current, and v1/exact-five compatibility passes. Shared handler/catalog/MCP/browser wiring remains pending a reviewed design and exclusive ownership transfer. Repository-wide formatting is independently noisy on pre-existing archived evidence and was not rewritten. Browser throughput, Kimi admission, Pixel consumption, downstream acceptance, commits, and Measure closeout remain incomplete.

sprint.goal: Let authors reuse deterministic multi-DOF rigid rigs and immutable poses across arbitrary clip libraries, then deliver and visually admit the resulting temporal artifacts through the real Forge-to-Pixel workflow.

stories.title: Define Reusable Rig and Pose Contracts
